findings.citation_text: These techniques leverage changes in reflected wireless signals, such as WiFi [8], RFID [9], and mmWave [10], to infer sound-induced vibrations, enabling the recreation of sound information.
findings.reasoning: The target RFID work [9] is listed as one representative wireless-based method for sound eavesdropping, positioned within a group of related techniques (WiFi, RFID, mmWave). This is a representative grouping, not a detailed attribution of sub-mm level vibration sensing.
